# ovirt_template (Data Source)

The ovirt_template data source returns the ID and details of a template by its name or ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) oVirt ID of the template. Either name or id must be specified.
- `name` (String) Name of the template. Either name or id must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the template.
- `status` (String) Status of the template (e.g. ok, locked).
